subject: Release hedging and automated swap for A/B rollout — SLA contingency plan
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <ops@acme-health.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme-health.com
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: A/B rollout plan — avoiding SLA hits

Hi Aditya,

Quick note from Ops at Acme Health — we’re planning the two-arm A/B rollout for the new triage assistant next week. Our SREs are asking for explicit runtime safeguards: if the B variant starts causing 5xxs or >150ms P50 above baseline for a sustained window, we want an automated swap to the stable variant and a temporary version pin until we can debug.

Key asks:
- An automated fallback (autoswap) trigger we can trust that won’t thrash traffic.
- A pinning mechanism so the stable variant remains pinned for N hours after rollback.
- A short SLA carveout/exception that documents the process and preserves our uptime commitments.

Can Redwood confirm you can implement the autoswap + pin for this deal and what approvals you need on your side? We’ll also need the SLA exception paperwork for procurement.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Rivera
Director, Platform Ops — Acme Health

Attachments: acme-multi-variant-map.pdf (diagram of traffic split + expected metrics)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <ops@acme-health.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: A/B rollout plan — avoiding SLA hits

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can support an autoswap + temporary pin workflow for Dedicated/Hosted accounts; we’ve used this pattern in a couple of healthcare pilots. High-level proposal below: 

Proposal (short):
- Trigger window: 10m rolling window, autoswap if error-rate >3% OR P50 latency delta >150ms compared to stable baseline.
- Cooldown: once autoswap occurs, pin stable variant for 4 hours by default (configurable by customer).
- No-thrash guard: require 3 consecutive trigger windows before swap to avoid transient flips.
- Audit + rollback: every autoswap is logged; we surface an immediate dashboard alert and a Doc link with playbook.

Next steps I need from Acme: sign SLA-exception-form (attached) and confirm desired pin duration (we can do 2 / 4 / 12 hrs). On our side I need an internal exception approval for this customer-specific autoswap behavior (it deviates from standard routing policies).

I’ve cc’d Laura for approvals and product coordination. If you’re good with the default 4hr pin, I’ll start the internal approval and attach the SLA carveout to the deal record.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
+1 (650) 555-0193

Attachments: sla-exception-form.docx

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: exception approval for autoswap+pin (Acme Health, ACME-2026-059)

Laura — forwarding Acme’s request and the proposed configuration. TL;DR: customer wants automatic swap to the stable variant if metrics degrade, with a temporary pin after swap. They asked for the default 4-hour pin.

Why this matters:
- This is a live healthcare prod rollout so uptime assurances are critical.
- Autoswap reduces human intervention time but changes our routing semantics slightly (we’ll be programmatically changing live traffic).

Proposed approval ask (product + legal ops):
- Approve autoswap trigger thresholds (10m window, >3% errors OR >150ms P50 delta), 3-window confirmation, 4-hour pin.
- Approve inclusion of a short SLA carveout in procurement paperwork that documents the rollback/pin process.

Impact: minimal to platform if limited to this account; we will schedule a quick config review with Kubench and SREs.

I’ve attached the SLA form the customer will sign. Happy to jump on a 20m call with you + Marissa to go over telem.

— aditya

On Thu, Sep 3, 2026 at 11:00 AM aditya_rao@redwood.ai wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can support an autoswap + temporary pin workflow for Dedicated/Hosted accounts.

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-04T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exception approval for autoswap+pin (Acme Health, ACME-2026-059)

Aditya — reviewed with Product and Reliability. Approve the exception with the following conditions: 

Conditions for approval:
- Keep thresholds conservative: use 10m rolling window, require BOTH (a) 3 consecutive windows and (b) at least one of the two signals (error-rate >3% OR P50 delta >150ms). This reduces false positives.
- Pin duration: default to 4 hours, but allow customer to extend to 12 hours via a signed change order.
- Telemetry retention: persist pre- and post-swap traces for 72 hours and attach to the audit record.
- Legal: add the carveout clause to procurement that documents the autoswap/pin as a mitigation step; procurement will own the wording.

Operational ask for SRE/Product: schedule a 30m kickoff with Acme’s SRE (Alex) and Marissa to confirm dashboard alerts and playbook steps. Marissa — can you own that and confirm a slot tomorrow morning?

I’ll sign the internal exception now and we’ll mark the deal with a platform note.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations — Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-09-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: A/B rollout plan — avoiding SLA hits (Approved)

Alex / Procurement — good news: internal approval is granted with operational conditions. Summary for Acme Health: 

What Redwood will configure for ACME-2026-059
- Autoswap trigger: 10-minute rolling window, require 3 consecutive windows AND (error-rate >3% OR P50 delta >150ms).
- No-thrash guard: the 3-window confirmation reduces flip risk.
- Pin duration: default 4 hours post-swap (can be extended to 12 hours via change order).
- Telemetry & audit: we will persist pre/post swap traces for 72 hours and attach them to the audit record.
- Paperwork: attach SLA exception form to the HubSpot deal; procurement to complete signature.

Next steps (action items):
1) Alex: confirm you want the default 4hr pin or request 12hr.
2) Procurement: we’ve attached the sla-exception-form.docx to the HubSpot deal — return signed copy.
3) Marissa: please schedule a 30m kickoff with Alex tomorrow AM to configure alerts and verify dashboarding.

If everyone is aligned I’ll mark the deal as "SLA-exception-approved" and schedule the config change during the maintenance window.

Thanks all — excited to get this rollout live and keep the uptime guarantees intact.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
